scenarios.name: add-test-coverage
scenarios.description: User asks dirge to add tests for untested functions — agent surveys code, proposes targets, writes tests, runs them

turns.speak: look at agent.rs and tell me which functions don't have tests yet
add tests for describe_items and parse_quantity first, those sound important
run the tests and tell me how many passed
great, now add a test for the edge case where parse_quantity gets an empty string

scenarios.name: fix-type-error-iteratively
scenarios.description: User reports a compile error — dirge reads the file, proposes fix, iterates when first attempt fails

turns.speak: I'm getting error E0308 mismatched types in call.rs line 242, can you look at it
try that fix
it's still failing with the same error, what else could it be
ok that second approach sounds better, apply it
build and run call_handler tests to confirm it's fixed

scenarios.name: refactor-extract-trait
scenarios.description: User asks dirge to extract an Agent trait from concrete implementations — full plan-approve-execute-verify cycle

turns.speak: I want to extract an SttEngine trait from the engine implementations, there are three backends
yes, survey the code first, show me your plan before making changes
that plan looks good, go ahead and implement it
now add doc comments to the new trait methods
run the full test suite to make sure nothing broke

scenarios.name: git-workflow-voice
scenarios.description: User manages git entirely by voice — status check, selective staging, descriptive commit

turns.speak: show me what files have changed since the last commit
stage agent.rs and call.rs but leave the other files alone
commit with the message: add word-boundary matching to IntentRouter and Action::Order variant
now show me the commit I just made with the full diff

scenarios.name: debug-runtime-panic
scenarios.description: User reports a runtime panic — dirge reads backtrace, asks clarifying questions, adds instrumentation, identifies fix

turns.speak: the server panicked with index out of bounds in stream.rs line 156, here's what happened: the window slide step was larger than the buffer
it happens when the audio chunk is smaller than the window, maybe a very short call
I like the guard approach, add that and also log a warning when this happens
now write a unit test that reproduces the short-chunk scenario to make sure it doesn't panic
run that specific test and confirm it passes

scenarios.name: multi-file-rename
scenarios.description: User asks to rename a symbol across the entire project — agent surveys usage, confirms scope, applies refactor

turns.speak: rename the struct CallConfig to CallSettings everywhere in the project
yes, rename it everywhere including tests and the benchmark binary
build the project and run the tests to verify nothing broke

scenarios.name: add-feature-from-spec
scenarios.description: User describes a new feature verbally — agent asks for clarifications, proposes implementation plan, executes, iterates

turns.speak: I want to add a retry mechanism to the transcribe function so it retries up to three times on transient errors
exponential backoff sounds right, use one second initial delay and double it each time
start implementing that plan
add a config option so the max retries can be set from the command line
now add tests for the retry logic including the backoff timing
run all the tests one final time

scenarios.name: code-review-voice
scenarios.description: User asks for code review of recent changes — agent reads diff, reports issues, user picks which to fix, agent fixes and verifies

turns.speak: review the uncommitted changes in agent.rs and tell me if there are any issues
fix the word-boundary issue you mentioned, the other two seem fine for now
actually, also add a safety check for empty input in trigger_contains like you suggested
build and run the agent tests to confirm both fixes work

scenarios.name: explain-and-document
scenarios.description: User asks agent to explain a complex function, then document it — knowledge transfer via voice

turns.speak: explain what the StreamingPipeline run method does, step by step
what happens if the audio is silent for more than the window duration
add doc comments to the run method explaining the sliding window and silence gate behavior
also add a module-level doc comment at the top of stream.rs explaining the overall pipeline architecture
